definitions: A roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place.
A complete and closed path around which an electric current can flow.
A series of athletic exercises performed at several stations in sequence.
A regular journey made by a judge or other professional to various places to perform duties.
examples: The earth takes a year to make a circuit of the sun.
A short circuit caused the power failure.
He joined the professional tennis circuit.
The judge is currently on circuit.
